mapper.select: SELECT ol.ProductId AS ProductId, SUM(ol.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity, COUNT(*) AS Lines FROM Sales.OrderLines AS ol INNER JOIN Sales.CustomerOrders AS o ON o.CompanyId = ol.CompanyId AND o.OrderId = ol.OrderId INNER JOIN Sales.OrderLineAllocations AS a ON a.CompanyId = ol.CompanyId AND a.OrderId = ol.OrderId AND a.LineNumber = ol.LineNumber LEFT JOIN Sales.Products AS p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId WHERE ol.Quantity >= #{minQuantity} AND o.CustomerId IN ( SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerId FROM Sales.Customers AS c WHERE c.CustomerId IN ( SELECT o2.CustomerId FROM Sales.CustomerOrders AS o2 WHERE o2.OrderId IN ( SELECT ol2.OrderId FROM Sales.OrderLines AS ol2 WHERE ol2.UnitPrice > ( SELECT AVG(p2.UnitPrice) FROM Sales.Products AS p2 WHERE p2.ProductId IN (1, 2, 3))))) AND EXISTS ( SELECT a2.AllocationId FROM Sales.OrderLineAllocations AS a2 WHERE a2.CompanyId = ol.CompanyId AND a2.OrderId = ol.OrderId AND a2.LineNumber = ol.LineNumber AND a2.AllocatedQuantity > ( SELECT MIN(ol3.Quantity) FROM Sales.OrderLines AS ol3 WHERE ol3.ProductId = ol.ProductId)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT p3.ProductId FROM Sales.Products AS p3 WHERE p3.ProductId = ol.ProductId AND p3.UnitPrice < ( SELECT MAX(ol4.UnitPrice) FROM Sales.OrderLines AS ol4 WHERE ol4.CompanyId = ol.CompanyId)) AND (ol.Description IS NOT NULL OR ol.UnitPrice > ( SELECT AVG(ol5.UnitPrice) FROM Sales.OrderLines AS ol5 WHERE ol5.Quantity > 0)) GROUP BY ol.ProductId HAVING SUM(ol.Quantity) > #{minTotal} ORDER BY ol.ProductId ASC OFFSET #{skip} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{take} ROWS ONLY
